Underroot is not a dungeon; it is a concealed neighborhood of root rooms, low lanterns, and people who survive below the route economy. Keep hidden communities human, practical, and self-protecting. Root arches and carved shelves form rooms where the forest is ceiling, wall, and witness. Lanterns are shielded so light does not betray doors above. Air holes are hidden inside harmless knots. Leaf-drip, insects, distant wingbeats, and animal calls that stop or resume according to pressure, not comfort. Cool earth, root sap, cooking smoke kept low, and stored herbs. Walls are ribbed with living root; touching them feels like touching something asleep. The forest is populated even when no NPC is present; silence, birds, insects, and tracks are actionable signals.
